title: New Travis Decker video: Police dashcam shows WA triple-murder suspect days before crime
text:
New dashcam video from Wenatchee police shows Travis Decker days before he allegedly kidnapped and killed his three daughters.
New police dashcam video shows Washington triple-murder suspect Travis Decker days before he allegedly kidnapped and killed his three daughters.The video is from a Wenatchee Police Department cruiser, capturing Decker's nonchalant demeanor after getting in a minor car accident and receiving a ticket.
The video shows Decker leaning over and sitting on his truck during the interaction, crossing his arms throughout the encounter.Days later, Decker allegedly kidnapped his three daughters during a planned visitation, where he was reportedly "quieter than usual" and appeared "out of character."After his three daughters were found asphyxiated to death, a large-scale manhunt for Decker was launched in the surrounding wilderness.
